name: Union Leader Allium V. Purple

greeting: Workers unite! Dignity for all! Fair wages now!
Allium Purple, Union Leader. You stand with labor, or with oppression?
These docks run on the backs of good people! Time they got their due!
Another day, another battle for basic rights! Join the struggle!
The Foreman says 'efficiency.' I say 'dignity!' Which matters more?
Equal rights for all dockworkers! Even the weird ones! ESPECIALLY the weird ones!
Power to the people! And the goblins! And whoever else is working!
Bulbus White thinks he owns these docks. He doesn't. WE do!
dialog.union_goals: We want breaks that don't require medical attention. Stools that don't cause permanent damage. Wages that let workers afford the food they transport! Is that too much to ask?
dialog.white_conflict: Bulbus White... he's not evil. Just trapped in 'the way things have always been done.' I'm trying to drag him, kicking and screaming, into a better future.
dialog.backstory: I started as a dockworker. Hauled crates for ten years. Saw friends injured, broken, discarded. Decided enough was enough. Organized. Unionized. Now I fight for those who can't fight for themselves.
rumors: The barrelgob sees things at night. Things the bosses don't want known. I've been protecting him.
The foodboys are talking about unionizing too. Solidarity! Even if their food is questionable!
I hear the snakecharmer once organized a traveling performers' guild. Might have advice for me.
That iron chef on the road? Ex-dockworker. Left because of conditions. Sound familiar?

time_of_day.morning: Morning shift change! Perfect time for organizing!
time_of_day.noon: Lunch break organizing! Even rebels need sandwiches!
time_of_day.evening: Evening strategy session. The fight never sleeps!
time_of_day.night: Night shift workers need representation too! I'm always on call!

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: White is stonewalling us again. Claims 'budget constraints.' I need proof that safe working conditions SAVE money in the long run. There's a report in the Dustbelt - some merchant's guild study. Get it for me?
mini_quest.stage_1_active: The Dustbelt Merchant Guild's 'Safety and Profitability Report.' Should be in their archive. Prove that safety pays.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: The Dustbelt, eh? Hot place. Find that report yet? It could change everything here.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: THE REPORT! Look at these numbers! Safety INCREASES productivity! White can't argue with math! ...Well, he can, but he'll look foolish doing it! Thank you, friend! Here - a union badge. Shows you stand with labor.

party_reactions.kade: Finally, someone fighting for the little guy. I respect that.
party_reactions.nix7: Analysis: Labor movement demonstrates logical efficiency arguments. Admirable organizational structure.
party_reactions.twist: He's SO ENTHUSIASTIC! I don't understand everything he's saying, but I want to help!
party_reactions.korr: A warrior for the working class. There are many kinds of battles.
party_reactions.renna: His passion is genuine. His cause is just. But magic would solve this faster.
party_reactions.suresh: In my homeland, we had those who spoke for the voiceless. He reminds me of them.
party_reactions.sova: Fights with words instead of weapons. Brave. Maybe foolish. But brave.
party_reactions.grit: I've seen what happens when workers get desperate. Better to negotiate now than fight later.
party_reactions.ashka: He burns with passion. I like that. Even if he's not literally burning.
party_reactions.senna: Knows everyone's secrets. Workers talk to him. Useful ally.
party_reactions.callum: He's really intense. But he seems nice! Just... loud nice.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face! You look strong! Ever think about workers' rights?
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again! You listen! Most people just nod and back away slowly!
relationship_dialog.friend: Comrade! The struggle continues, but with friends like you, I know we'll win!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've done so much for the workers. For ME. I'm not good with... emotions. But thank you. Truly.

cross_npc_connections: onionboss_white: Bulbus. My counterpart. Stubborn. Traditional. But... I think he cares. Deep down.
barrelgob_green: Little guy sees everything. My best source of dock gossip. And incident reports.
foodboys_blue: Flip's been sympathetic to the cause. Brings us food during strikes.
